bio.text: Kristin Hook is the Democratic candidate for Texas's open 21st Congressional District in the November 2026 election and was also the district's Democratic nominee in 2024.
A Corpus Christi native, Kristin Hook earned two bachelor's degrees from the University of Texas at Austin and a doctorate in behavioral biology from Cornell University.

Hook joined Teach for America after college and later worked as a post-doctoral researcher, as an oversight investigator for Sen. Elizabeth Warren through an AAAS fellowship, and at the National Institutes of Health and the Government Accountability Office.
